alerts.title: Conflicting provenance identity
alerts.description: A stable provenance identifier was reused with incompatible immutable evidence.
recommended_actions: Preserve the existing immutable provenance record.
Reject the conflicting capture attempt.
Review the producer's stable-ID generation and retry behavior.

alerts.title: Malformed provenance event
alerts.description: A generic provenance event did not satisfy the ProvenanceAgent event contract.
recommended_actions: Reject the malformed event without inventing missing provenance.
Verify the event_type and payload fields against ProvenanceAgent.record_event().
Retry only after the producer emits an unambiguous provenance payload.

alerts.title: Cyclic lineage rejected
alerts.description: Artifact, checkpoint, or transformation ancestry would introduce or expose a provenance cycle.
recommended_actions: Reject the cyclic relationship.
Inspect parent/child direction and stable identities.
Correct the producer data before retrying.

alerts.title: Unknown provenance reference
alerts.description: A requested artifact, source, checkpoint, parent, or provenance record is not known to the current provenance state.
recommended_actions: Confirm the stable identifier is correct.
Register or restore the missing provenance fact if it is actually known.
Do not fabricate an unknown parent or source to complete the graph.

alerts.title: Source identity missing from reconstruction evidence
alerts.description: The reproducibility report indicates that source identity is not known for the target artifact.
recommended_actions: Inspect the artifact's lineage and source_ids.
Register the source only when its identity is known.
Re-run the reproducibility report after provenance capture is corrected.

alerts.title: Checkpoint ancestry conflict
alerts.description: Checkpoint provenance conflicts with immutable checkpoint identity or would form invalid ancestry.
recommended_actions: Preserve the existing checkpoint provenance fact.
Verify the parent checkpoint and model association.
Correct conflicting checkpoint metadata before retrying.

alerts.title: Checkpoint provenance missing
alerts.description: A requested checkpoint provenance record is not present in ProvenanceMemory or ProvenanceStore.
recommended_actions: Verify the checkpoint identifier against CheckpointManager output.
Record provenance about the checkpoint if the physical checkpoint exists and its metadata is known.
Do not create a synthetic checkpoint provenance record without evidence.

alerts.title: Custody continuity conflict
alerts.description: The supplied previous custodian does not match the currently recorded custodian for the artifact.
recommended_actions: Reject the conflicting custody transition.
Retrieve the current chain-of-custody.
Submit a new transition only when the previous custodian is consistent with recorded history.

alerts.title: Provenance persistence failure
alerts.description: Durable provenance storage or local ProvenanceMemory persistence failed.
recommended_actions: Preserve the original exception and operation context.
Verify the configured provenance storage or manifest location and writable state.
Retry only after the persistence condition has been corrected.

alerts.title: Provenance checkpoint manifest cannot be interpreted
alerts.description: ProvenanceMemory could not normalize or load its checkpoint manifest because the structure, identities, or schema are inconsistent.
recommended_actions: Do not overwrite the manifest automatically.
Preserve the failed manifest for inspection.
Restore from a known valid provenance manifest or reconstruct local references from authoritative ProvenanceStore facts.

alerts.title: Unsupported provenance schema version
alerts.description: A ProvenanceStore, ProvenanceMemory, or ProvenanceAgent checkpoint schema is incompatible with the current implementation.
recommended_actions: Reject incompatible persisted state rather than coercing it silently.
Confirm the producing SLAI version and supported schema.
Perform only an explicitly supported compatibility conversion.

alerts.title: Reconstruction evidence is incomplete
alerts.description: The reproducibility report is structurally valid but one or more required provenance requirements are missing.
recommended_actions: Inspect missing_requirements rather than treating completeness as a quality score.
Capture only provenance evidence that is actually known.
Regenerate the reproducibility report after missing provenance is recorded.

alerts.title: Derivation reconstruction failed
alerts.description: Lineage capture or reconstruction raised a provenance lineage/tracking error rather than returning a valid graph/path result.
recommended_actions: Preserve the lineage error context.
Inspect referenced entities, relations, and transformation identities.
Do not convert a reconstruction error into a fabricated derivation path.
